title: PixelMind
tagline: Digital Art Minded AI Agent which can learn, inspire, and craft based on NFT's art styles 🤩 🎨
description: PixelMind designed to be an AI Agent buddy for an artist. The agent could learn the artist artstyle, vibes, brush, sketch, colors, objects, anything from the artist. The agent currently learn onchain from the owned NFTs. We plan to have the agent also can read the created NFTs, not limiting to the owned only. Once the agent learnt, they could inspire the artist to create an artwork. The artist can use input as an inspiration, and then the agent will draw something that similar to their artstyle. We plan to have the agent to read from NFT or images to make artist being inspired easily. We also plan to pay respect to the copyright by attaching the inspiration etc onchain.
how_its_made: We used CDP Agentkit from Coinbase as our Agentic Framework. Then we use various tools, for example like getting Onchain Data we used Moralis. Including getting the NFT images. For the LLM we utilize OpenAI. OpenAI includes a lot of tooling, from Vision to read images, to DALL-E 3 to generate images. And then we used monorepo thanks to Turbo and NPM. Also we utilized some common tools or libraries like expressjs and reactjs. And also we deployed our agent in our partner, Autonome. Their support means a lot to us.
